info.name: LuminaMind - API (reports, medications, home, doctor, chat)
info.description:
Automatic tests for the LuminaMind ts-server beyond /auth.

Run: `npm run test:api` (folders 0-6; folder 9 = known issues, `npm run test:known-issues`) (server must run, use a TEST database, see postman/README.md).
Every run creates its own patients A and B and its own doctor (unique e-mail addresses).
The tests only look at the API answers, so they pass with ENCRYPTION_ENABLED=true and false alike.

item.name: 9. Known issues
**Known issue:** partial update must keep the other fields (message)

exec: pm.test("message is still 'Better after lunch.'", function () {

request.description: reportUpdateSchema = reportInputSchema.partial(). Fields with a default (message, activeMedications) are filled with their default when they are missing, so a PUT with only {mood} overwrites the saved message with an empty text.

item.name: **Known issue:** report with an invalid id must answer 400 or 404, not 500

request.description: Mongoose throws a CastError for an id that is not an ObjectId. It is not mapped to a 4xx status.

item.name: **Known issue:** medication with an invalid id must answer 400 or 404, not 500
**Known issue:** chat history with an invalid contact id must answer 400 or 404, not 500
**Known issue:** doctor must not read the summary of a patient who is not connected (patient B)

request.description: getPatientHistoricalSummary does not check that patientId is in the doctor's connectedUsers. Any doctor can read (and send to the AI) the data of any patient whose id is known.

item.name: **Known issue:** doctor summary with an invalid patient id must answer 400 or 404, not 500
**Known issue:** a patient must not be able to message a user he is not connected with (patient A -> patient B)

request.description: sendMessage only checks that the receiver exists. Chats should be limited to connected doctor/patient pairs.

item.name: **Known issue:** setup for the next three: patient B adds a medication
**Known issue:** doctor must not read the medications of a patient who is not connected (patient B)

request.description: getMedications takes patientId from the query for every doctor, without checking connectedUsers.

item.name: **Known issue:** doctor must not change the medication of a patient who is not connected (patient B)

request.description: updateMedication looks the entry up by id only when the user is a doctor.

item.name: **Known issue:** doctor must not delete the medication of a patient who is not connected (patient B)
**Known issue:** doctor must not add a medication for a patient who is not connected (patient B)
**Known issue:** doctor with an invalid patientId must answer 400, not 500
**Known issue:** a message with only spaces must answer 400, not 500

request.description: The schema checks min(1) before trim(), so '    ' passes the check, becomes '' and then fails the Mongoose required validator (500).

item.name: **Known issue:** a user must not be able to message himself

item.description: These requests check how the API SHOULD behave. They fail today and show real gaps found while writing the tests. Run them with `npm run test:known-issues`. Once a gap is fixed, move its request into the normal folders.
